name: Companion Cavalry
pitch: A mid-tier seasonal cavalry with a complex stacking rotation that rewards precision positioning. No published counters exist — guides pre-date the current patch, so matchup weaknesses are unconfirmed.

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: Achilles' Wings: +20% movement speed, +100% Imperial Stormbolt charge DMG, renames unit.

battleRole.positioning: X-move in and position for stacking rotation. Press 3 for buffs even while hero fighting — it applies global +100 DMG stats wherever you are.
battleRole.tips: Optimal vs low-armor/low-HP targets: press 1 for chip DMG before the combo. For standard foes, go directly to the 2-stack. Cancel 1 with V, press 2 shortly after contact, then cancel 2 with V when ~70% of the unit is impaled — this unlocks the new 1. Try to X-move out before 1 fully resolves, but don't cancel too early. If you need immediate actions, prioritize 2 (Storm Pound) over optimization.

controls.notes: Ability 3 applies global +100 all DMG stats and Sworn Guard buff (18s duration) — can activate mid-combat or even while hero is fighting. Ability 2 is Storm Pound. If you need immediate actions, prioritize ability 2 over full combo optimization. {1}
